verdict.rationale: CrewAI's Flows are documented as a way to build AI automations from autonomous agents and crews. AMP deploys crews to managed infrastructure that are started via POST /kickoff, polled via GET /status, and can stream events by webhook, so they can run unattended rather than in an interactive session. A community user's email-triage crew confirms autonomous automation works in practice. Missing for 10: documented scheduling or event triggers (cron or app-event kickoff), and independent hands-on corroboration of long-running background execution on the managed platform.
